settings.visualStyle: Grounded cinematic first-person WWII urban realism at Arnhem, September 1944. British 1st Airborne POV, Dutch streets, brick houses, canal edges, damaged interiors, dust, smoke and the distant bridge. Non-graphic and physically restrained.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds. No spoken dialogue, narrator or intelligible speech. POV faction remains British 1st Airborne. Nearby friendlies are British airborne troops. German forces remain clearly separate in opposing streets, vehicles or distant positions. Use quiet interiors and waiting beats between short exposed movement.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person airborne reenactment with brick dust, window light, cramped interiors, street scale reveals, tired movement and natural sound recovery.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP09 — Arnhem: Streets to the Bridge
movie.storySummary: A fictional British airborne soldier moves through Arnhem streets toward the bridge area, shelters inside damaged houses, crosses exposed roads, helps shift supplies and ends in a battered defensive position overlooking the city.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Make the viewer feel trapped in a Dutch city battle through brick dust, stairs, windows, narrow streets, distant vehicles and exhausted waiting. No dialogue or narration.

scenes.title: Dutch Street
scenes.actionDescription: He walks beside a brick wall behind British airborne troops, rifle slung.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person red-brick Dutch street, maroon berets/helmets among friendlies, bicycles and shuttered windows.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow wall-hugging walk. Audio: boots, gear, distant gunfire, wind.

scenes.title: Bridge Glimpse
scenes.actionDescription: He peeks around a corner and catches a distant glimpse of the bridge structure.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person corner peek, long street perspective, bridge steel visible far away, rifle low.
scenes.videoPrompt: Lean out, brief reveal, lean back. Audio: city wind, distant engines, breath.

scenes.title: Broken Hallway
scenes.actionDescription: He enters a damaged house and brushes brick dust from sleeve.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dim hallway, broken plaster, brick dust on British airborne sleeve, rifle partly off-frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Step from street into dim interior. Audio: boots, plaster crunch, distant battle muffled.

scenes.title: Window Watch
scenes.actionDescription: He kneels below a window and slowly raises eyes to the street.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person low window sill, brick chips, empty street segment, weapon resting below frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow rise to window edge and hold. Audio: distant vehicle, glass tick, breath.

scenes.title: Armored Noise
scenes.actionDescription: A German armored vehicle moves across a distant intersection and he drops below the sill.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person brief distant opposing armored vehicle crossing street, British cover foreground clearly separate.
scenes.videoPrompt: Brief sighting then quick duck. Audio: tracked vehicle rumble, brick dust, breath.

scenes.title: Tea Tin Water
scenes.actionDescription: He drinks a small amount of water from a metal mug while seated on stairs.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person mug, dusty knees, narrow Dutch stairway, rifle leaning against wall.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quiet drink. Audio: mug clink, distant shelling, breathing.

scenes.title: Supply Bundle
scenes.actionDescription: He lifts an ammunition bundle with both hands and passes it upstairs.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands passing British ammunition package to friendly airborne sleeve.
scenes.videoPrompt: One controlled handoff. Audio: canvas, metal, wood stair creak.

scenes.title: Cross the Street
scenes.actionDescription: He makes one short dash across a narrow street to another doorway.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person sprint across Dutch road, rifle low and offset, British doorway ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Fast crossing then hard stop inside doorway. Audio: boots, gear, distant bursts.

scenes.title: Canal Edge
scenes.actionDescription: He crouches near a canal wall and studies reflections and smoke.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hand on damp brick canal edge, water reflecting gray sky and smoke.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow downward look then across water. Audio: water lap, wind, distant fighting.

scenes.title: Bridge Larger Now
scenes.actionDescription: Moving between buildings, he sees the bridge much closer through a gap.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person alley opening onto larger view of Arnhem bridge, British position foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Confined alley to bridge reveal. Audio: wind, distant engines, breath.

scenes.title: Brick Cellar
scenes.actionDescription: He sits in cellar shadow and flexes dusty fingers.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dusty hands, brick cellar, rifle resting on floor, friendly boots nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static recovery. Audio: muffled battle, dust fall, breathing.

scenes.title: Firelight Outside
scenes.actionDescription: He looks through a cracked doorway at orange glow from a distant burning vehicle.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person doorway slit, distant fire on opposing street, brick interior foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow lean to doorway and hold. Audio: fire crackle distant, city echoes.

scenes.title: Bandage Roll
scenes.actionDescription: He passes a clean bandage roll to a British medic off-frame; no wound shown.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person bandage handoff to medic sleeve, non-graphic, dusty room.
scenes.videoPrompt: Simple handoff. Audio: fabric, distant battle, breath.

scenes.title: Upper Floor View
scenes.actionDescription: He climbs to upper floor and looks over damaged rooftops toward bridge.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person broken upstairs window, rooftops, smoke, bridge beyond, rifle off-frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Climb last steps into wide city reveal. Audio: floor creak, wind, distant guns.

scenes.title: Hold Until Dark
scenes.actionDescription: He rests both hands on the window ledge as daylight fades over Arnhem.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dusty hands on sill, evening city and bridge, British position foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Near-still dusk hold. Audio: wind, distant battle, tired breathing. Fade.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.description: Anonymous British airborne soldier during Operation Market Garden at Arnhem.
characters.mainOutfit: British airborne battledress, airborne helmet, web gear, service rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Nearby friendlies remain British 1st Airborne. German troops and vehicles remain clearly separate. Preserve brick dust, fatigue and gear continuity.

atmosphereAssets.title: Arnhem Streets
atmosphereAssets.description: Brick streets, junctions, canal edges and distant bridge views.

atmosphereAssets.title: Damaged Dutch Houses
atmosphereAssets.description: Broken hallways, stairs, cellars and windows used as British cover.

atmosphereAssets.title: Bridge Defensive House
atmosphereAssets.description: Battered British position nearer Arnhem bridge.
